mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note (user_id, book_id, content, summary, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{content}, #{summary}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, book_id AS bookId, content, summary, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
